name: Andrzej Halicki - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Union Solidarity Fund to provide assistance to Austria, Poland, Czechia, Slovakia and Moldova relating to floods occurred in September 2024 and Bosnia and Herzegovina relating to floods occurred in October 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament approves releasing money from the European Union Solidarity Fund to help six places hit by floods in 2024. Austria, Poland, Czechia, Slovakia and Moldova get aid for the September floods, and Bosnia and Herzegovina for the October floods. In total, about 280.7 million euro is released. The report also asks the Commission to make the fund bigger and faster in future, because natural disasters are becoming more frequent and severe.

- About 280.7 million euro is released for flood recovery in six countries.
- People and regions in Austria, Poland, Czechia, Slovakia, Moldova, and Bosnia and Herzegovina benefit.
- Parliament's President signs the decision with the Council, then it is published and takes effect.
